records.failureSummary: Ran the QA verification. The static contract file test/ac-dockerfile-contract.test.js exists and passes (6/6), the AC-30 audit passes (3/3), and the full `node --test` suite is 227 passed / 0 failed / 0 errors, so nothing is red. However the task's acceptance criteria are only partially satisfied by the assertions actually present, so the deliverable cannot be marked complete. Gaps: (1) AC-24 only asserts FROM node plus an install and a start command; it never asserts Dockerfile existence nor the rest of the docker build input set (.dockerignore, package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, src/server.js) as a completeness check. (2) AC-25 asserts only the Dockerfile VOLUME /data; it does NOT assert that README's docker run example mounts a data volume at /data and sets DATA_DIR=/data. (3) AC-26 is fully covered (non-root USER plus /data ownership and user/group creation). (4) AC-29 asserts only that the Dockerfile has no log redirection; it does NOT assert application logging goes to stdout rather than a file, nor scan Dockerfile/README/example commands for plaintext password or secret constants. This agent's sandbox is read-only, so the missing assertions could not be added and a follow-up test task is required.
